Weak Hero Class 1

약한영웅 Class 1

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2022

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐∞/10

Overview

Yeon Si-eun is a top student who appears physically weak but possesses extraordinary intelligence. When he becomes the target of ruthless school bullies, he uses his intelligence and anything around him to survive. Along the way, he forms an unlikely friendship with the fearless Ahn Su-ho and the timid Oh Beom-seok. Together they fight against school violence, but their friendship is eventually torn apart by jealousy, betrayal, and tragedy.

My Review

I loved this series. Imagine Si-eun, an introverted guy, meeting someone like Su-ho, who is extroverted, together with Beom-seok. I hate Beom-seok because he was the one responsible for why Su-ho ended up in a coma. I understand that he experienced bullying and pain in life. As someone who was adopted by an assemblyman—not because he was loved, but only for public image—I know he suffered. But it was still not a reason to hurt the people who genuinely cared for him. I know he was tired of feeling useless, defenseless, and looked down upon. And I know Su-ho never treated him badly. Beom-seok was just ignorant because he had money and didn't realize how privileged he was to have su-ho nd si-eun as friends. I know he felt that he was left out since the time yeong-i joined their circle - her close bond with suho cause beomseok to feel insecure and jealous which led him betray his friends, leaving Suho in a coma and Sieun devastated. I really loved Su-ho and Si-eun. I wish I had a friend like Su-ho—someone who would fight for you no matter what. The fact that Si-eun punished everyone responsible for Su-ho's coma, yet couldn't bring himself to hit Beom-seok, broke my heart. The ending was so sad.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Si-eun, Su-ho, and Beom-seok slowly becoming best friends. • Every fight where Su-ho protected Si-eun without hesitation. • Si-eun using his intelligence to defeat stronger opponents. • The emotional final confrontation between the three friends. • Si-eun silently visiting Su-ho after he falls into a coma.

Favorite Quote/Lines

“Wake up, man. Stop blaming others.”
